name: duplicates and both ranking orders
test:
w = WindowKth(10)
w.add(0, 7)
w.add(1, 3)
w.add(2, 7)
assert w.kth(2, 1) == 3
assert w.kth(2, 2) == 7
assert w.kth(2, 3, 'largest') == 3
assert w.kth(2, 4) is None

name: inclusive lower boundary and later expiration
input: events at times 2 and 3, five-unit window
test:
w = WindowKth(5)
w.add(2, 10)
w.add(3, 20)
assert w.kth(7, 1) == 10
assert w.kth(8, 1) == 20
assert w.kth(9, 2) is None

name: current window excludes old stream history
input: one hundred increasing events, short window
test:
w = WindowKth(3)
for i in range(100):
    w.add(i, i)
assert w.kth(99, 1) == 96
assert w.kth(99, 4) == 99
assert w.kth(99, 2, 'largest') == 98
assert w.kth(99, 5) is None
assert w.kth(1000, 1) is None

name: empty stream and single item
input: query before and after one event
test:
w = WindowKth(2)
assert w.kth(0, 1) is None
w.add(1, -5)
assert w.kth(1, 1, 'largest') == -5
assert w.kth(4, 1) is None
